thread:
tessa: Quick sync: planned coordinated window Sat 03:00-06:00 UTC. Order suggestion: router prewarm -> runtime canary -> api staged -> console patch. Need a compact rollback lattice and explicit runbook commands.

omar: Router prewarm first to stabilize route tables. Also want a small prewarm verification: 5m low-traffic smoke.

ryan: Agree. Pin/fallback matrix proposal: router header-swap v2.0 (rollback v1.8), runtime v9.0 (fallback v8.8), api v2.50 (fallback v2.49), console change behind feature flag.

lina: Canaries: router 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%; runtime 1% -> 15% -> 50% -> full; api 1% -> 20% -> full. console hold at 10% until router is stable at 25%+. Keep kernel flags frozen.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT checks running: config-lock, schema-compat, dep-graph, infra-headroom.

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT RESULTS: config-lock OK, schema-compat NOTE (console telemetry added optional field, guarded), dep-graph OK, infra-headroom OK.

omar: console guard ok. Add client-side tolerance for the optional field and enable feature-flag default off, ramp to on post-deploy.

ryan: router risk from prior header-swaps: KV miss storms causing runtime thrash. Recommend bump router cache TTL to 40m and set runtime conservative eviction for 1h after the router swap.

tessa: added TTL bump and eviction guard to playbook. Rollback lattice draft:
- If runtime health < 93% for 5m -> rollback runtime to v8.8 and route traffic to stable replica pool in us-east.
- If API request_error_rate > 2% for 4m -> pin API to v2.49 and pause runtime progression.
- If router header-swap failure rate > 0.6% for 5m -> rollback router to v1.8 and restore previous route table.

oncall-bot: ALERTS FOR WINDOW: request_error_rate > 1.7% for 4m -> page #platform-oncall; p95 latency +45% over baseline for 3m -> notify #infra; runtime OOM >=2 in 10m -> auto-rollback runtime; header-swap fail rate >0.6% -> rollback router.

lina: manual abort clause: any CS-facing outage reported -> immediate pause + full rollback to pinned last-stable across services.

ryan: Adding gapless runbook snippets for oncall:
```
# rollback runtime to 8.8
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version 8.8 --reason "health trigger"
# pin api to 2.49
deploybot pin --service api --version 2.49 --note "emergency pin"
# rollback router to 1.8
deploybot rollback --service router --to-version 1.8 --note "header-swap regressions"
```

omar: I'll rehearse these in staging and validate alerting. Keep a 15m soak between major waves; extend if any warning.

deploybot: SCHEDULE: dry-run smoke 02:50 UTC; Wave 1 (router prewarm) 03:00 UTC; Wave 2 (runtime canary) 03:30 UTC; Wave 3 (api staged) 04:15 UTC; Wave 4 (console feature flag ramp) 05:00 UTC.

tessa: Assigning watchers: omar -> router cache + header metrics, ryan -> runtime evictions/OOMs, lina -> console telemetry and feature-flag ramp, I'll watch API errors and global traffic. Please ack with your metric.

omar: ack — watching router kv-miss, cache-hit%, and header-swap errors.

ryan: ack — watching runtime eviction-rate, memory pressure, and OOMs.

lina: ack — watching console schema logs and feature-flag toggles.

deploybot: REMINDER: quiet-window 03:00-06:00 UTC. Non-critical merges blocked.

tessa: thanks team. Posting runbook link and handing off to oncall. Ending thread. :tada:
